text_en: Now a man from the house of Levi went and married a Levite woman.
text_cn: 有肋未家族的一个男子娶了肋未家族的一个女人为妻。

text_en: The woman conceived and bore a son; and when she saw that he was a fine baby, she hid him three months.
text_cn: 这女人怀孕生了一个儿子，见他俊美，就把他藏了三个月。

text_en: When she could hide him no longer she got a papyrus basket for him, and plastered it with bitumen and pitch; she put the child in it and placed it among the reeds on the bank of the river.
text_cn: 以后不能再藏了，就拿了一个蒲草筐子，涂上沥青和石漆，把孩子放在里面，将筐放在尼罗河边的芦苇丛中。

text_en: His sister stood at a distance, to see what would happen to him.
text_cn: 孩子的姐姐远远的站着，想知道孩子究竟怎样。

text_en: The daughter of Pharaoh came down to bathe at the river, while her attendants walked beside the river. She saw the basket among the reeds and sent her maid to bring it.
text_cn: 当时法郎的一个公主下到尼罗河边洗澡，使女们在河边上徘徊。公主发现芦苇丛中那个筐子，就吩咐自己的使女将筐子取来。

text_en: When she opened it, she saw the child. He was crying, and she took pity on him. “This must be one of the Hebrews’ children, ” she said.
text_cn: 她打开一看，见有一个孩子正在哭涕，就动了可怜他的心说：“这必是一个希伯来人的孩子。”

text_en: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and get you a nurse from the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you? ”
text_cn: 孩子的姐姐就对法郎的公主说：“你愿意我去从希伯来妇女中给你请一个奶妈，为你乳养这个孩子吗？”

text_en: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Yes. ” So the girl went and called the child’s mother.
text_cn: 法郎的公主回答说：“你去吧！”少女便去叫了孩子的母亲来。

text_en: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and nurse it for me, and I will give you your wages. ” So the woman took the child and nursed it.
text_cn: 法郎的公主对她说：“你将这孩子抱去，为我乳养他，我必给你工钱。”那妇人就接过去，乳养这个孩子。

text_en: When the child grew up, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and she took him as her son. She named him Moses, “because, ” she said, “I drew him out of the water. ”
text_cn: 孩子长大了，那妇人就把他带到公主那里；公主遂收他作自己的儿子，给他起名叫梅瑟，说：“因为我从水里拉出了他。”

text_en: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to his people and saw their forced labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his kinsfolk.
text_cn: 过了许久，梅瑟已经长大，有一次出去探望自己的同胞，看见他们作苦工，又见一个埃及人打他的一个同胞希伯来人；

text_en: He looked this way and that, and seeing no one he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.
text_cn: 他向四面一望，见没有人，便将那埃及人打死，将他埋在沙土中。

text_en: When he went out the next day, he saw two Hebrews fighting; and he said to the one who was in the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow Hebrew? ”
text_cn: 第二天他又出去，见两个希伯来人打架，就对那无理的一方说：“你为什么打你同族的人？”

text_en: He answered, “Who made you a ruler and judge over us? Do you mean to kill me as you killed the Egyptian? ” Then Moses was afraid and thought, “Surely the thing is known. ”
text_cn: 那人回答说：“谁立了你作我们的首领和判官？难道你想杀我，像杀那埃及人一样吗？”梅瑟就害怕了，心里想：“那事一定叫人知道了！”

text_en: When Pharaoh heard of it, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from Pharaoh. He settled in the land of Midian, and sat down by a well.
text_cn: 法郎听说这事，就想杀死梅瑟；而梅瑟却离开法郎逃走，去了米德杨地，坐在井旁。

text_en: The priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came to draw water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
text_cn: 米德杨的司祭有七个女儿，她们来打水，灌满水槽，要饮父亲的羊群。

text_en: But some shepherds came and drove them away. Moses got up and came to their defense and watered their flock.
text_cn: 别的牧童来了，赶走了她们；梅瑟便起来保护了她们，也饮了她们的羊。

text_en: When they returned to their father Reuel, he said, “How is it that you have come back so soon today? ”
text_cn: 她们回到父亲勒乌耳那里，父亲问她们说：“你们今天为什么回来的这么快？”

text_en: They said, “An Egyptian helped us against the shepherds; he even drew water for us and watered the flock. ”
text_cn: 她们回答说：“有一个埃及人救我们摆脱了牧童的手，还给我们打水饮了羊群。”

text_en: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why did you leave the man? Invite him to break bread. ”
text_cn: 他对女儿们说：“他在哪里？你们为什么撇下他？去请他来吃饭！”

text_en: Moses agreed to stay with the man, and he gave Moses his daughter Zipporah in marriage.
text_cn: 于是梅瑟决定住在那人那里，那人将自己的女儿漆颇辣给了梅瑟为妻。

text_en: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom; for he said, “I have been an alien residing in a foreign land. ”
text_cn: 她生了一个儿子，梅瑟给他起名叫革尔熊，因为他说：“我在外方作了旅客。”

text_en: After a long time the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned under their slavery, and cried out. Out of the slavery their cry for help rose up to God.
text_cn: 过了很久，埃及王死了。那时以色列子民由于劳苦工作，都叹息哀号：他们因劳役所发出的求救声，升到天主面前。

text_en: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
text_cn: 天主听见了他们的哀号，就记起了他与亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯所立的盟约。

text_en: God looked upon the Israelites, and God took notice of them.
text_cn: 天主遂眷顾了以色列子民，特别垂念他们。
